verdict.rationale: Alloy is a hosted identity and fraud-decisioning SaaS, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it offers a self-hosted or on-prem deployment, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents vendor-hosted API bases (sandbox.alloy.co and api.alloy.co) and a Sandbox processing mode that is not a separate environment. Nothing in the pack shows a self-hostable distribution or on-prem option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
